notes.title: Early Access - 0.1.8 - Goodbye Town
notes.content:
[h2]Goodbye Town[/h2]
It was a hard decision to make, but the town building system took up too much development time to release consistent updates to the game. It was a cool idea, but it was not fleshed out enough to be anything more than a glorified menu for unlocking new pet groups.

[b]Pet groups will now be automatically unlocked simply by ascending[/b]. I know that this decision will upset some of you who have grown fond of your little pet town, but in order to continue creating the best pet petting experience possible it was important for me to re-evaluate the games core features and cut the fat.

[h2]Other things[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Added milestones for combos
[/list]

tags.feature: Pet groups will now be automatically unlocked simply by ascending
Added milestones for combos

notes.title: Early Access - 0.0.3 - Day/Night, Nicknames, and New Legendary Pet
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you to the community for sticking with me[/h2]
I have been trying to figure out why there is no Add to Cart or Buy option on the Steam store for Let's Pet Pets. I have contacted support and am waiting eagerly to hear back from them to resolve this issue. In the meantime please join the [url=https://discord.gg/NWNpGAbXDV]Discord server[/url] and let me know what you want to see in future updates.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a Day/Night cycle to the game (Based on Realtime)
[*] Pets can now have an affinity for certain times of day (increasing pet point production)
[*] Added ability to rename pets as suggested by [u]DarkestDemon[/u] on Discord
[*] Added a new Legendary dog as a pet in honor of the curator [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36690498-Can-You-Pet-the-Dog/]Can You Pet the Dog[/url]
[/list]
